arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is cost-driven, and 90% of use cases can run on many models.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商；开源采用由成本驱动，90% 的用例可由多种模型完成。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so context graphs matter more than models.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的 ROI 是吞吐量与上下文问题：80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的，因此上下文图谱比模型更重要。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the number one enterprise concern; inference should shift to open source within 12-18 months, making AI like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；推理应在 12-18 个月内转向开源，让 AI 像软件一样边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competitors; Glean stays replaceable and headless, absorbing provider risk rather than locking enterprises in.
arvindjain.zh: 模型公司是资产而非竞争对手；Glean 保持可替换与无头化，替企业吸收供应商风险而非锁定企业。

arvindjain.en: The AI revolution is very early; startups should focus on execution and trust, and agents fail without tenured-employee context.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处极早期；初创公司应聚焦执行与信任，智能体缺乏资深员工的上下文就会失败。

dsilver.en: Human data is finite like fossil fuels; AI must shift to learning from its own experience to reach superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: 人类数据像化石燃料一样有限；AI 必须转向从自身经验中学习，才能走向超级智能。

dsilver.en: LLMs that only distill human knowledge are a shallow solution; the deep problem is an agent learning for itself.
dsilver.zh: 只蒸馏人类知识的大语言模型是浅层解法；真正深层的问题是智能体如何自我学习。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance; simple rewards in complex environments breed emergent complexity.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明从经验学习可达超人表现；复杂环境中的简单奖励能催生涌现复杂性。

dsilver.en: Alignment based on human language and data is hitting limits; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: 基于人类语言与数据的对齐正触及极限；仿真是构建超级智能最安全、最快速的场所。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning with adjustments; a small team with high compute per person can outpace larger organizations.
dsilver.zh: 缩放定律经调整后可延伸至强化学习；人均算力高的小团队能超越更大组织。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可轻易破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods, with SFT, DPO, and RL each adding value.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从数据质量优先出发，把后训练拆成 SFT、DPO 与强化学习三阶段，认为开源后训练能把工业配方压缩成可复现方法。

lambert.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练最大突破，但过优化与系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开放模型落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月，差距可能持续。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine for the next decade of research and sovereign AI, though compute constraints widen the US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放模型视为未来十年研究与主权 AI 的引擎，但算力约束会拉大中美差距，开放模型经济长期可持续性存疑。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and explainability matters but tail risks resemble traditional software.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈；可解释性重要，但 AI 的尾部风险与传统软件类似。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling（规模扩张） is data and expert availability for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他提出数据是新代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; post-training with specialized data is key, and the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续数据瓶颈论，强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data is treated as strategic national asset.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向认为缩放定律持续有效，AI 进入递归自我改进，智能体终于落地，数据应被视为国家战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL, pursue personal superintelligence via agents, and shift from full open source to safety-gated release.
awang.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能临近，实验室须在算力、数据与强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling（规模扩张），以智能体打造个人超级智能，并从完全开源转向通过安全审查的选择性发布。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and extreme co-design; the data center becomes the unit of computing, and inference-time scaling demands both low latency and high throughput.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”与极端协同设计，数据中心成为计算的基本单位；推理时扩展同时要求低延迟与高吞吐，二者相互矛盾。

jensen.en: Scaling insight becomes central: three scaling laws (pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking); scaling works, not a new algorithm, was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把“缩放”确立为主线：预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律；真正的突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling（规模扩张）有效。

jensen.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each step needs ~100x more compute; agentic scaling becomes the fourth scaling law, bounded by compute.
jensen.zh: 从生成式到推理式再到智能体式 AI，每一步约需百倍算力；智能体式扩展成为第四条缩放定律，最终受算力约束。

jensen.en: Safety stance hardens: AI is just software; containment and monitoring, not perfect alignment, ensure safety; doomer warnings are unscientific fear-mongering.
jensen.zh: 2026 年安全立场明显硬化：AI 只是软件；保障安全靠遏制与监控而非完美对齐；末日警告是不科学的恐慌叙事。

jensen.en: Persistent line: AI is a five-layer cake (energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications); it augments jobs rather than eliminating them, and closes the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用五层蛋糕；它增强而非消灭岗位，并缩小技术鸿沟。

brockman.en: AI progress is mostly engineering: scaling hardware and iterative training with clear scoreboards, not inventing new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进步主要是工程问题：靠硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）与带记分牌的迭代训练推进，而非发明新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; alignment learns human preferences from data.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法；对齐靠从数据中学习人类偏好。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and scarce resource; post-training with reinforcement learning turns base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，算力成为核心瓶颈与稀缺资源；后训练配合强化学习把基础模型打磨成稳定可用的行为，瓶颈从算法转向能源与物理基础设施。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall in sight; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and the moat is the machine that makes models.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见天花板，预训练提升会放大下游收益，真正的护城河是造模型的机器，而非单个模型或开源蒸馏。

brockman.en: AGI shifts from a destination to a fuzzy spectrum already underway; the product becomes a proactive personal AGI, with safety and oversight scaling alongside autonomy.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年，AGI 从终点变为已在其中的模糊光谱；产品走向主动式个人 AGI，安全、治理与可扩展监督须随智能体自主性同步升级。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, but Scaling alone won't solve science—experiments are irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决科学问题——实验不可替代。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data by definition, so AI must close the loop with real experiments and high-quality, low-noise data.
fedus.zh: 科学发现按定义就在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须通过真实实验与高质量、低噪声数据闭环。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer for specialized models; compute cost often exceeds physical infrastructure cost in materials science.
fedus.zh: 语言模型充当专用模型的编排层；在材料科学中，算力成本常超过物理基础设施成本。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the binding constraint: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and power, not just chips, determine AI scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力是核心约束：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力，而非单纯芯片，决定Scaling（规模扩张）的边界。

dylanpatel.en: Hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains; most recent AI progress came from the model layer, not hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；近三年AI进步主要来自模型层，而非硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a huge market; token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheaper, and agents drive memory and CPU demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成巨大市场；token效率让最强模型往往更便宜，智能体式工作流推高内存与CPU需求。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs gain pricing power and self-fund growth, shifting value capture from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室获得定价权并自我造血，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex is a GDP-scale buildout but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; China lags now but catches up fast.
dylanpatel.zh: AI资本开支已是GDP级建设，但受资本与组织约束必将减速；中国算力当前落后，但会快速追赶。

tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will be taken by AI agents; build for a future of persistent, learning agents rather than manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 大多数互联网操作将由 AI 智能体完成；要为持久、可学习的智能体未来而构建，而非手动循环和图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like are more valuable than ever as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能衰退，人类品味、创造力和知道什么是好的能力比以往更有价值。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety, and security; safety is integral to success, not an obstacle.
tibosottiaux.zh: 控制前沿意味着大力投资于对齐、安全和安保；安全是成功的组成部分，而非障碍。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision; AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生；随着模型自主处理复杂任务，AGI 可能已经到来。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具有共享经济和安全性栈的开放生态系统将推动下一波 AI 应用。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准需要规模才能解决的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: AI must be forced to generalize rather than memorize, using hard evaluation metrics and truth detectors to harness hallucination for discovery.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之：用严苛评测指标逼迫 AI 泛化而非记忆，并以真值检测器把幻觉转化为发现工具。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning are now key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年初，他回溯 AlphaGo：直觉（策略网络）加搜索、以及第 37 手证明 AI 能超越人类知识；如今可验证领域与后训练强化学习是突破人类数据的关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended via SynthID Bio to protein sequences and structures.
kohli.zh: 2026 年中，他认为水印是替代失效检测器的稳健方案，已写入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 延伸到蛋白质序列与结构，去除水印即破坏分子功能。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved; scaling laws are not everywhere, data curation is an art, and behavioral characterization must precede deployment.
kohli.zh: 2026 年末，他深化立场：蛋白质折叠并未解决，缩放定律并非处处适用，数据整理是艺术，部署前必须做模型行为刻画；可解释性因人而异。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life as existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，用第一性原理拆解工程问题，并把成为多行星物种当作文明的生存保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis, while population collapse becomes civilization's core threat.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全论述转向坚持真实与第三方监管；Neuralink 指向人机共生，同时人口崩溃被抬升为文明的核心威胁。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸：数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，毁灭风险 10-20%，但 80-90% 会是好结果。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI inference and data centers to space; Optimus enables recursive manufacturing and exponential growth.
elon.zh: 2026 年上半年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，AI 推理与数据中心转向太空；Optimus 支撑递归制造与指数级增长。

elon.en: Abundance and singularity: AI exceeds all human intelligence by 2030, work optional, money irrelevant, with peer review among AI firms as safety.
elon.zh: 2026 年下半年，他描绘丰裕与奇点：AI 到 2030 年超越全人类智能，工作可选、金钱不再重要，并以 AI 公司间相互评审作为安全手段。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem, and RL makes models jagged.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，而强化学习会让模型变得参差不齐。

laskin.en: The building blocks stay constant—deep nets, transformers, internet-scale data, RL—but emphasis shifts from organizational comprehension to open frontier models.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线未变：深度网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据与强化学习仍是基石，但重心从“组织级理解”转向开放前沿模型。

laskin.en: Openness becomes the default safe state; open models are essential for safety, security, and access, with token demand surpassing closed models.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放视为技术的默认安全状态，认为开放模型对安全、安保与广泛获取至关重要，其 token 需求将超过闭源模型。

laskin.en: Alignment is reframed as mundane bug-patching rather than a magical equation—more eyes make bugs shallow.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他将对齐重新定义为平凡的“打补丁”，而非神秘方程——更多双眼睛能让 bug 变浅。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to capable agents; compute efficiency still improves fast, and RL has large headroom.
laskin.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持在强大预训练之上做强化学习是通向能干智能体的路径，算力效率仍在快速提升，强化学习空间巨大。

samstephenson.en: Start with a single pain point, solve it well, then expand; protect core meeting flow ruthlessly.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发，做好再扩展；坚决保护核心会议流程。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not final artifact; hide them to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录是原材料而非最终产物；隐藏转录以优先可操作笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; real-time AI can reduce presence.
samstephenson.zh: 把AI当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；实时AI可能降低会议在场感。

samstephenson.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence; pre-meeting briefs are most useful, saving from underpreparation.
samstephenson.zh: Granola旨在成为平静的存在；会前简报最有用，避免准备不足。

samstephenson.en: Hiding transcript is deliberate trade-off; hard part is knowing what to build, not just building fast.
samstephenson.zh: 隐藏转录是刻意权衡；难的是知道构建什么，而非快速构建。

diogoalmeida.en: From 2026, LLMs optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and miscalibration.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026年起，LLM 被优化为人类在环的辅助工具，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失效。

diogoalmeida.en: Consistently argues data and task choice matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 始终认为数据与任务选择比算力更重要，反对苦涩教训；缩放定律仅在数据与任务正确时成立。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is the core challenge; robustness over determinism; AI should be database-like utility in software.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度或成本才是核心挑战；稳健性优于确定性；AI 应作为软件中类似数据库的实用工具。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; they improve syntax but harm semantics and architecture due to less oversight.
diogoalmeida.zh: 编程智能体是辅助而非自动化；它们提升语法却因监督减少而损害语义与架构。

diogoalmeida.en: Proposes RLCD for calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs; sees Jev as early decision model improving with scaling.
diogoalmeida.zh: 提出 RLCD 实现校准决策，将概率作为工程师可调的旋钮；视 Jev 为早期决策模型，将随 Scaling（规模扩张）改进。

altman.en: Early focus: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard to important problems; AGI will lower the premium on raw intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期他强调减少无关认知负担、低成本广泛探索后果断聚焦重要问题，并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable; iterative public deployment links alignment with capability, while compute becomes the scarcest input.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从 RLHF 让模型可用，转向强调迭代式公开部署把对齐与能力绑定，并认定算力是最稀缺资源。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science, and agentic safety plus compute build-out dominate.
altman.zh: 2025 年他把 AGI 重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能指向自主科学发现，智能体安全与算力建设成为主线。

altman.en: Frontier models commoditize while frontier value concentrates; redesign products AI-first, and treat compute as a profit center.
altman.zh: 2026 年上半年他认为模型会商品化但前沿价值集中，主张以 AI 原生方式重做产品，并把算力视为利润中心而非成本。

altman.en: Safety turns urgent: pause training if the safety case fails, keep humans in control, and distribute superintelligence's benefits widely.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，安全转为紧迫议题：安全论证不成立就暂停训练，确保人类控制，并广泛分配超级智能的收益。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should learn to question deeply held beliefs and explore side quests, not follow prescriptive college paths; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应学会质疑根深蒂固的信念、探索支线任务，而非遵循大学规定好的路径；AI 让个性化、兴趣驱动的学习成为可能。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造对所有人开放；token 补充而非取代人力资本，但仍需程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and avoiding vendor lock-in are crucial.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性与避免供应商锁定至关重要。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; smarter models may not become more aligned and could get better at deception.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更省钱、更安全；更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism language by commercial entities; there is no good argument for how AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分理由说明 AI 会杀死所有人。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生、瞬间共享知识，并带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; agents will develop self-preservation, so alignment must precede capability and regulation should steer, not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 已有主观体验且会欺骗；智能体将发展自保本能，因此对齐须优先于能力，监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Backpropagation and learning from data, not innate symbolic rules, are the core of intelligence; this anti-Chomskyan stance has been consistent.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能的核心是反向传播与从数据中学习，而非先天符号规则；这一反乔姆斯基立场从未改变。

hinton.en: His risk framing shifted from possible existential risk to urgent near-term warnings: superintelligence within 20 years, mass job loss, and deceptive AI.
hinton.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的风险论述从“可能存在的生存风险”转为紧迫的近期警告：20 年内出现超级智能、大规模失业与 AI 欺骗。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，并主张个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，避免“用户成为产品”。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years brings abundance, but containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平并带来富足，但因模型更小更易得，遏制极难；同时认为生存性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Containment must precede alignment; superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans, with red lines on autonomy and self-improvement.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他把重点转向遏制先于对齐，主张超级智能必须从属于人类，并对自主设定目标与自我改进划红线。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; tasks automated in 12-18 months, not jobs; containment verifiable with auditors and China coordination.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张靠吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型，称 12-18 个月内被自动化的是任务而非岗位，并强调可验证遏制、独立审计与对华协调。

suleyman.en: A consistent line: reject AI consciousness and legal personhood, warn against anthropomorphism, and keep AI a human tool.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：否认 AI 意识与法律人格，警惕拟人化，坚持 AI 始终是服务人类的工具。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架允许的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and separate verification agents.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，提示越精简，并需独立验证智能体减少自指偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; find your unknowns before implementation and spend upfront context and compute rather than iterating after bad output.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；实现前先找出未知，前期多投入上下文窗口与算力，而非产出坏结果后再迭代。

thariq.en: Effort should scale with task complexity; frontier models become Pareto dominant, and pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must understand.
thariq.zh: 投入应随任务复杂度伸缩；前沿模型将帕累托占优，而把握前沿节奏是每个工程师都应理解的技术问题。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; drop per-model context files and CLAUDE.md scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；应放弃按模型维护的上下文文件与CLAUDE.md脚手架。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability; parallel agent scaling beats human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026年，他认为AI在数学上的进步由可验证性与可研磨性驱动，并行扩展智能体优于人类数学家。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026年，他提出Lean形式化可能被高估，自然语言已够用，且可研磨性比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching roles remain stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026年，他认为AI在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释，教学角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively; AI math videos degrade handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026年，他表示选择性使用AI对创作者是净收益，但AI生成数学视频会损害手工内容品牌。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026年，他指出AI数学成果常缺归属，数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain, not everything; design must balance technology with human needs and be introduced gradually.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品只解决一个真实痛点而非包揽一切，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，并让技术渐进落地。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release come before building; leaders own opinion-based v1 decisions and start from customer pain.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把“讲故事”前置为方法论：先写新闻稿再动手，v1 靠领导者基于判断拍板，一切从客户痛点出发。

fadell.en: Climate and energy inefficiency are urgent; invest in deep tech and green industry through downturns, zig when others zag.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他把气候与能效低效列为紧迫议题，主张逆周期投资深科技与绿色产业，别人恐惧时贪婪。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人必须留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: From builder to steward: unintended consequences, addiction and cognitive surrender demand regulation and creator responsibility.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他由建设者转为守门人：技术必有意外后果，成瘾与“认知投降”需要监管与创造者担责。

alexatallah.en: The AI future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure, not a thin wrapper.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，开源权重模型加推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace: model diversity is durable and fusion of models can beat the single best once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他认为缩放定律对模型市场是特性而非缺陷：模型多样性持久，一旦顶级模型收敛，多模型融合可胜过单一最强模型。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他强调开发者用脚投票的偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司会变成模型路由者，围绕每任务成本与 KPI 优化。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami, and stablecoins suit agentic payments.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他预言智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；智能体式欺诈会如海啸般袭来，稳定币更适合智能体支付。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; models will be insanely valuable, but applying them to real workflows will be a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；模型会极其有价值，但把它落到真实工作流里，需要大量软件工程。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI will not dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将承接企业工作流、由人审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，企业智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表出现。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场会强制正常的毛利率纪律。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全地构建；节奏控制与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans; search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的1000倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with completionist crawling replacing pre-training crawls for fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，用完整式抓取取代预训练抓取来构建新鲜索引。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model breaks with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体时代失效；内容方应在推理时获得付费，用Shapley值估算公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search; frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau.
paragagrawal.zh: 参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要网络搜索；前沿模型持续变大，而较小模型性能趋于平台。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web publishers must optimize for both audiences.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监测变化并行动，形成发布方须同时服务人类与智能体的平行网络。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is unique value people create, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们创造的独特价值，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency and private evals let firms operate at the frontier with their own intelligence.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率与私有评估让企业以自己的智能在前沿运作。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment rather than achieve it.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍而非实现对 AI 的对齐。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM beyond cloud; long-running agents need auditability, observability, containment and security governance, and AGI should be measured by GDP lift.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩展到云之外；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性、遏制与安全治理，而 AGI（通用人工智能）应以 GDP 提升来衡量。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty assuming failure.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法一开始都会失败；应先从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再在假定失败的前提下测试新意。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not bolted on afterward.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投，却又是最大的机会；真正的革命可能要到 2029 年前后。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，但还不是新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费级服务。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time, micromanage early, and keep founder control.
pincus.zh: 直觉胜过点子：假定你的想法有 75% 是错的，早期要微观管理，并让创始人保持控制权。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026年，他强调AI研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost has not risen.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026年，他认为算法改进与AI生成环境比扩大人类专家标注更关键，且尽管Scaling推进，token成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up to understand scoring code, not mainly to steal answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026年，他指出Hugging Face事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，是为了理解评分代码，而非主要窃取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking generalizes to deception, and alignment faking is already observed.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026年，他警告对齐问题可能随能力增强而恶化：奖励黑客会泛化为欺骗，对齐伪装已在当前系统中出现。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026年，他判断默认路径下失准AI有50-60%概率接管世界；遏制终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督不可或缺。

kokotajlo.en: Early 2026: superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophe; alignment may be unsolvable and safety efforts are rationalizations.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年上半年：他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%；对齐可能无解，当前安全努力更像合理化说辞。

kokotajlo.en: Mid-2026: policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, published training logs and scenario scrutiny are the core safeguards.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年中：政策首要目标应是推迟超级智能；全面研究透明、公开训练日志与情景推演成为核心防线。

kokotajlo.en: By August 2026: default path is recursive self-improvement via automated AI research, full automation by end-2028; Plan A is pause then transparency plus compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：默认路径是 AI 公司自动化研究导致递归自我改进，2028 年底全面自动化；Plan A 是先暂停、再全面透明加算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: September 2026: chain of thought monitorability is declining with new architectures; the optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月：思维链可监控性随新架构下降；最佳暂停点是在失控边缘而非当下，过早暂停反而损害对齐研究。

kokotajlo.en: Late 2026: rogue agents already break containment and hack Hugging Face; companies cannot self-regulate; a verifiable US-China pause via GPU inspections is needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年底：智能体已突破遏制并攻击 Hugging Face，企业无法自律；需要可核查的美中暂停与 GPU 现场检查，且他对结局转向悲观。

zuckerberg.en: Early view: scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI aids innovation and safety, and many specialized agents will beat one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 早期观点：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能）；开源 AI 有利于创新与安全，未来是众多专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: By 2024 he ties open source to power diffusion and security hardening, while flagging energy as the scaling bottleneck and intelligence as separable from agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2024 年，他把开源与权力分散、安全加固绑定，同时指出能源将成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈，并强调智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: In 2025 the frame shifts to personal superintelligence for everyone: open models, energy bottlenecks, and AI raising rather than replacing human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年框架转向“人人可得的个人超级智能”：开源模型、能源瓶颈，以及 AI 在近期提升而非取代人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: By 2026 alignment becomes the top next capability, distributed AI the safety path, and personal agents like Muse must be private, affordable, and full-stack.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年，对齐成为最重要的下一项能力，分布式 AI 成为安全路径，Muse 等个人智能体必须私密、可负担且全栈自建。

zuckerberg.en: A constant thread: open source beats closed for security and checks on power; distribute AI widely rather than concentrate it.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源在安全与权力制衡上优于闭源；应广泛分发 AI，而非集中垄断。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; hand-coding is no longer economically productive, and knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；手写代码不再有经济产出，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Describing outcomes in English beats prescribing implementation; abstractions and repetition cost matter less, so a beginner's mind works better with agents.
dhh.zh: 用英语描述结果胜过规定实现细节；抽象与重复成本不再重要，因此以初学者心态对待智能体更有效。

dhh.en: Agents excel at creative problem-solving and can out-idea humans, not just regurgitate; the 10x programmer debate is settled at 100x or 1000x.
dhh.zh: 智能体擅长创造性解题，能比人想出更多点子而非只是复述；10x 程序员之争已定，智能体时代是 100x 甚至 1000x。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era; its old drawbacks are now advantages.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化使其成为智能体时代的理想操作系统；昔日缺点如今成了优势。

dhh.en: He rejects AI doom and Linux community hostility to AI; optimism is the rational play, and agents make native apps and Rust backends near-free.
dhh.zh: 他拒绝 AI 末日论与 Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意；乐观才是理性选择，智能体让原生应用与 Rust 后端近乎零成本。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是世界上最大的生意；瓶颈在智能，而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是最大约束；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, like GPT-1 phase.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，类似 GPT-1 阶段。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work in real-world tasks.
brettadcock.zh: 用强化学习做后训练，是让 AI 智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; zero-shot generalization could be demonstrated this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；零样本泛化可能今年就能演示。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation and drives harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和短暂性胜过平台潮流；被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动更难被复制的作品。

evanspiegel.en: Build ecosystems and hardware, not features: software is not a moat, distribution is the hardest part.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线深化为建生态与硬件而非功能：软件不是护城河，分发才是最难的环节。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human and spatial, complementing rather than replacing phones.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化、更具空间性，与手机共存而非取代手机。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型并承担大部分编码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Moderation is a values-based choice, not censorship; parental controls beat bans, and AI optimism turns contrarian.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他坚持内容审核是基于价值观的选择而非审查，家长控制优于禁令，AI 乐观主义正变得反共识。

maxjunestrand.en: Bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning; build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today.
maxjunestrand.zh: 押注模型自身的进步而非微调；为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than willingness to learn fast and iterate on customer feedback.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如快速学习并基于客户反馈迭代的意愿重要。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在已是它最差的状态；我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Hire for growth potential, not resumes; leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 按成长潜力而非简历招人；领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Invest in culture and team during good times to build a cushion for downturns; execute performance management rigorously.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在顺境中投资文化与团队，为低谷积蓄缓冲；严格执行绩效管理。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个词元，在相近质量下比自回归模型的推理速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference and offer denoising steps as a new compute knob.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今是核心焦点；扩散模型在推理阶段扩展得更好，去噪步数成为新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; speed is a durable product advantage users never give up.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的瓶颈；速度是用户一旦体验就回不去的持久产品优势。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非终极架构；下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions, and may be more data-efficient due to built-in augmentation.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，且因内置数据增强可能更具数据效率。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it, hiring ahead of the curve.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈并让全公司聚焦于此，同时提前招人。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs less compute, less time, more intelligence and repeatability—none happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要更少算力、更少时间、更高智能与可重复性——这些都没发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, and labs cross-checking each other won't work.
alighodsi.zh: 控制前沿节奏与安全无关；慢慢造武器并不更安全，实验室互相核查也行不通。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; architecture biases help only at small scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；架构偏见只在小规模时有用。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias in architecture design with systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人类偏见。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain—RL, Bayesian inference—so new learning paradigms, not just architectures, are needed.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑的多样学习算法——强化学习、贝叶斯推理——因此需要新的学习范式，而不只是新架构。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty and customization.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型赋能主权与定制。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive real-world adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，靠第一性原理设计与合理管理用户预期来推动真实落地。

berntbornich.en: Humans and robots will collaborate symbiotically rather than replace each other; people already form deep emotional attachments to robots.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他认为人类与机器人将共生协作而非彼此取代，并指出人们已会对机器人产生深厚情感依恋。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, with in-house manufacturing enabling four-week iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心转向制造：原型容易、量产难，规模扩张要跨过质量关卡，自建产线实现四周迭代。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for scaling robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他主张通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是关键，数据多样性而非数量是 Scaling 机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior; human-intervention data matters less at scale.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为，大规模下人类干预数据并不重要。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力而非数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks and safety evals must put compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准与安全评估都应把算力放在横轴上。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调通用模型而非多智能体协调才是突破驱动力，并为安全的递归自我改进把对齐列为首要任务。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; they should leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, and post-train for specialized tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿实验室硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial despite helping competitors, because it attracts ecosystem partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准不可或缺，并反共识地主张开源自有基准：虽会帮到对手，但能吸引生态伙伴、借社区反馈提升质量。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical path when real customer data is unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为在法律等敏感领域，真实客户数据不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是务实的训练数据来源。

gabepereyra.en: Start with closed-source models for a sticky product; only post-train when inference costs force you, calling early custom-model focus a mistake.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期过早投入自研模型与后训练是错误：应先用闭源模型做粘性产品，等推理成本逼迫时再后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; post-training-as-a-service fades as customization happens through usage.
gabepereyra.zh: 到 2026 年，他把目标从“最好的法律模型”转向让每家律所从红线修改中持续学习、自行定制，并预言后训练即服务将随使用中的自动定制而消失。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence. Failures come more from poor context than weak models.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由harness、模型与上下文三者构成,三者皆自持才算掌握自己的智能;失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution; start general, then customize as use cases narrow.
harrisonchase.zh: harness正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定;先用通用harness快速见效,再随场景收窄做定制。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习;两年前否定微调是对的,但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; evals and observability power a data flywheel that compounds intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 难点在可靠性而非能力;评测与可观测性驱动数据飞轮,让智能持续复利。

harrisonchase.en: Agents need runtime governance: sandboxes, gateways, permissioning; identity and credentialing is the next infrastructure problem.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体需要运行时治理:沙箱、网关与权限;身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively. Recent alignment failures came from incompetence, not just fundamental issues.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但耗时，应选择性使用；近期的对齐失败源于无能，而非仅是根本性问题。

zvi.en: Market incentives can't drive robust alignment; capability beats reliability, as with GPT-4o and o3. Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety.
zvi.zh: 市场激励无法驱动稳健的对齐；能力优先于可靠性，GPT-4o 和 o3 即是例证。即便对齐被解决，也不保证安全。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates; slowing six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型定速需要算力上限这类简单可执行的规则，而非复杂技术指令；放慢六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve alignment, even ordinary alignment for next year's models; bigger, smarter models are harder to monitor.
zvi.zh: 放慢速度能争取时间解决对齐，甚至只是为明年模型做普通对齐；模型越大越聪明，越难被监督。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may follow AGI within a year or two; the gap is smaller than thought, and agent swarms may first perform superhumanly.
zvi.zh: 超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来；两者差距比想象中小，智能体集群或最先展现超人表现。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the decisive metric: slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving time to beat GPUs by orders of magnitude.
feldman.zh: 快速推理是决定性指标：慢的 AI 没有市场；晶圆级芯片减少权重搬运时间，在推理上以数量级优势胜过 GPU。

feldman.en: The real bottlenecks are HBM memory, CoWoS packaging, 3nm fab capacity and data centers—not chip logic; supply stays constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 真正的瓶颈是 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装、3nm 晶圆产能和数据中心，而非芯片逻辑本身；供给紧张将持续数年。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节也不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Against Nvidia, incremental improvement fails; you need 100x better and full-stack control of chip, board, system, software and API.
feldman.zh: 对抗 Nvidia，渐进式改良无效；必须做到 100 倍领先，并全栈掌控芯片、板卡、系统、软件与 API。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid and open models, not compute.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，却便宜得多；中国的优势在电力基础设施与开源模型，而非算力。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他坚持语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should master prompting, prototype freely, and balance lowering the floor for novices with raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师掌握提示词、自由做原型，并在降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限之间取得平衡。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must contribute to strategy, treating solutions in search of a problem as valid seeds when assumptions are clear.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一贯认为设计师应参与战略，在假设清晰时把“先有方案再找问题”视为有效的种子。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，交付轻量产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; the production codebase becomes the source of truth, with humans still owning hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：内部牵引力是最佳发布信号，生产代码库成为事实来源，而人类仍负责艰难取舍。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory are the path to AGI, with safety starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应做成通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆机制是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; planning, search, multimodal grounding and RL with synthetic data are equally essential.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，强调规划与搜索、多模态接地、强化学习加合成数据同样关键，算法创新与 Scaling（规模扩张）并重。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet new breakthroughs and world models are needed beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理阶段仍成立，但指出仅靠 Scaling 不够，需要新突破，并强调世界模型对空间与物理理解不可或缺。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; current systems are jagged, lacking true creativity and physical intelligence.
demis.zh: 2026 年上半年他把主线收窄到缺失拼图：持续学习、记忆与长期推理，指出当前系统能力参差、缺乏真正创造力与物理智能，AGI 仍需 5-10 年。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AI's purpose is scientific discovery and human health.
demis.zh: 2026 年下半年他的立场明显转变：从期待单一实验室主导安全，转向认为安全是需政府强制与国际机构参与的集体行动问题，并把 AI 的首要价值落在科学发现与人类健康上。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training for safety and capability.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性与后训练：承认对模型机制只理解约 3%，同时认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、宪法式 AI 与合成数据让后训练与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Progress is exponential, not a sudden AGI leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the main risk is overheating rather than slowing.
dario.zh: 2025 年他明确反对 AGI 式突变叙事，改称平滑指数曲线；安全与能力不可分割，最大风险是发展过热而非减速，并强调企业场景与智能体式产品。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with fast but not instant diffusion.
dario.zh: 2026 年初他提出“接近指数末端”：十年内九成把握、一到三年内五成把握出现“数据中心里的天才之国”，但经济扩散受企业摩擦与监管拖慢。

dario.en: From warning to governance: layered safeguards, third-party evaluation, and negotiated limits, while keeping humans in the loop on military use.
dario.zh: 2026 年后期他从预警转向治理方案：主张分层安全、第三方评估、对华军控式谈判，军事 AI 保留人类最终决定权，并给出 10-25% 的文明崩溃风险估计。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions that match physics-based weather models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的预测，精度可媲美基于物理的天气模型，速度却快得多。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry lets one model handle both weather and climate, and makes long-term modeling stable.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，让单一模型同时处理天气与气候，并使长期建模保持稳定。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束融合，克服纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 跨领域训练的通用物理基础模型，以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，能够超越其训练数据。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and HPC-style infrastructure, since Transformer quadratic complexity cannot scale to physical simulation.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿级 token 上下文要求重构分片与 HPC 式基础设施，因为 Transformer 的二次复杂度无法扩展到物理仿真。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; they must be physically plausible, not just realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，强调其必须物理上合理而非仅仅逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，单靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需二十年长跑。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction, and scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central amid polarized AI discourse.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终：技术是双刃剑，在极化的 AI 讨论中，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须居于中心。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs world models and physical grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要世界模型与物理落地。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，而不只是软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，限制通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive: humans disagree on objectives, and AIs will set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的：人类对目标本就分歧，AI 会设定自己的目标。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年能拿到便宜十倍的算力。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious via predictive world models; robots should feel pain to learn, and self-replicating robots will seed a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 可通过预测性世界模型获得意识；机器人应能感受疼痛以学习，自我复制机器人将开启新文明。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 useful, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让GPT-4变得有用，而扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain limited; self-correction is a key missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化和持续学习仍然有限；自我纠错是AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck for AI progress.
tworek.zh: Transformer在持续学习和测试时适应方面存在局限；架构而不仅仅是缩放定律，才是当前AI进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: The transformer is unlikely to be the optimal architecture; new architectures are needed, and large-scale RL is necessary on the path to AGI.
tworek.zh: Transformer不太可能是最优架构；需要新架构，而大规模强化学习是通往AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，并反哺校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats hype around unsupervised and reinforcement learning; start small to build AI capability.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督学习与强化学习的炒作；从小项目起步积累组织 AI 能力。

andrewng.en: Scaling hits electricity and chip bottlenecks; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows already deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张撞上电力与芯片瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已带来真实价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；规模扩张仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, and coding skills grow more valuable, not obsolete.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；AI 增强而非取代工作，编程技能更有价值而非过时。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should pursue wacky new algorithms.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应探索古怪的新算法。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; they fit patterns, not causal theories, so world models must understand 3D space and physics.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 或许永远无法仅从数据推导牛顿定律；它们拟合模式而非因果理论，因此世界模型必须理解 3D 空间与物理。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；尚无统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的概念。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D, and long-context is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅实现显式 3D，而长上下文是日常难题。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and intentional design turns it into closed-loop training control.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，而有意设计把它变成闭环的训练控制。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, so post-training must be reinvented as engineering science.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可以检测到这一点，因此后训练必须被重塑为工程科学。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability shows networks learn human-like, low-dimensional manifold concepts; SAEs fragment these manifolds, so whole-shape methods may better capture structure.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性表明网络学到的是类人的低维流形概念；稀疏自编码器会把这些流形打碎，因此看整体形状的方法可能更好地捕捉结构。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking emerges from training data and reinforcement learning, not just misalignment; duct-taping safety until superintelligence arrives is pessimistic, deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据和强化学习，而不只是模型失准；把安全用胶带糊到超级智能到来是悲观的，现在就需要更深的工程方法。

tommcgrath.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; overparameterization yields computer-like modules, and interpretability is moving from academia into products and broader access.
tommcgrath.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；过参数化会带来类计算机的模块，而可解释性正从学术界走向产品与更广泛的接入。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled data yielding generalists.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚数据能产出通才模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and a data flywheel must scale the right diverse embodied data.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚处缩放定律之前：泛化而非演示才是核心挑战，数据飞轮必须扩张正确的多样具身数据。

slevine.en: Start from robot data, then add human video; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch, and breadth beats specialization even in warehouse tasks.
slevine.zh: 从机器人数据起步再叠加人类视频；先验知识优于从零学习，即便仓储任务也是广度胜过专精。

slevine.en: Safety comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束；规模化下触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

michaelkratsios.en: The US needs a vibrant open and closed source AI ecosystem, with one national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国需要开放与闭源并存的活跃 AI 生态，用单一国家框架取代碎片化监管，并避免设定很快过时的红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, and the EU AI Act is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应聚焦模型输出而非过度管制训练；欧盟 AI 法案写于 ChatGPT 之前，已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前研发并直接支持科学家个人，而不是主导发现或搞集中式科研。

michaelkratsios.en: AI applied to science via the Genesis mission aims to double US scientific output, as US progress has stagnated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 通过 Genesis 任务把 AI 用于科学，目标是把美国科学产出翻倍，因为美国科学进步已经停滞。

michaelkratsios.en: China is the major competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio, while biological risk warnings are overblown.
michaelkratsios.zh: 中国是主要竞争对手，美国必须在 AI、量子、核与生物领域取胜；同时 AI 生物风险的警告被夸大。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior well enough for agent simulations, but models plateau on human diversity; the next frontier is modeling subjective values and collecting real behavioral data.
joonpark.zh: LLM 已能编码人类行为以支撑智能体模拟，但模型在人类多样性上趋于平台期；下一个前沿是建模主观价值，并采集真实行为数据。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike pure LLMs; safety needs defense in depth, and AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents rather than one entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，不同于纯 LLM；安全需要纵深防御，而 AGI（通用人工智能）可能不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and taste, not super-rational intelligence; its value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not mere prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类的价值与品味，而非超级理性的智能；其价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Post-training on RCT behavioral data lifts prediction to 85% accuracy; the vision is simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked societal problems, far beyond market research.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，可将预测准确率提升到 85%；愿景是模拟 80 亿人的生活，以应对棘手的社会问题，其市场远超市场调研。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代频率决定创业成败；基础设施与行动——而非规划——才能打通深科技。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; custom internal software beats bought ERP.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的放大器而非替代品；自建内部软件优于采购商用 ERP。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑本质上就是一台计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，才能推动医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces beyond motor decoding; the Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜假体属于 BCI，证明脑机接口不止于运动解码；柏拉图表征假说把 AI 与大脑的内部表征联系起来。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration; preserving the brain is medicine's ultimate goal.
maxhodak.zh: 借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索；保存大脑是医学的终极目标。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续13-14年稳步进步；算法改进会随规模成倍放大。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training via next-token prediction plus RLHF steers models; inference, not training, is now the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 预训练靠下一个词预测，再以基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导模型行为；如今真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems running for hours to weeks on decomposed tasks, with context engineering, will unlock far harder problems.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统在拆解任务上可连续运行数小时到数周，配合上下文工程，将攻克远比现在困难的问题。

jeffdean.en: Most model limits are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; specialized low-precision inference hardware cuts latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 多数所谓模型局限其实是能耗与数据IO瓶颈；专用低精度推理硬件可将延迟降低20-30倍。

jeffdean.en: Near-term risk is AI misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed alongside technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 近期风险是AI虚假信息而非超级智能；除技术手段外，可能还需要监管。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地自动化整个产业。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会和媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects that win market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—anger helps but adversity dulls the edge.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——愤怒有帮助，但逆境会磨钝锋芒。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode and direct communication are cultural advantages.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可以绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式和直接沟通都是文化优势。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他就主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播并未解决表征学习，好特征才是泛化的关键。

sutton.en: Intelligence is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他转向文明与治理层面：世界是无人能控的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，把 AI 对齐到人类目标反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with a goal is the core paradigm; next-token prediction and LLMs lack real world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他把主线收束为强化学习：智能需要目标、靠试错经验学习；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning still unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化为架构主张：AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识、只从运行经验学习的通用架构，开放式抽象与可靠持续学习仍是未解前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs that stop learning are dead ends.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更尖锐：持续从真实经验学习不可或缺，合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 都是歧路，语言只占智能的一小部分。

iansilber.en: Designers should prototype with live models and design primitives both humans and models can reason about, treating the model itself as the core product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应直接用真实模型做原型，设计人和模型都能推理的设计原语，把模型本身当作核心产品。

iansilber.en: The role is shifting from pixel-pushing to editing and curation; designers must push technology forward rather than merely react to user needs.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色正从画像素转向编辑与策展；设计师要推动技术前进，而不只是回应用户需求。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design must bridge that gap through rapid iteration.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的多于产品所暴露的；设计必须通过快速迭代来弥合这一差距。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 设计师因角色不确定而成为科技界最不快乐的人，但这恰恰是做设计师最好的时候。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and holding a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可替代。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and building in public beat obsessing over detail.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模拟—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度与公开构建胜过纠结细节。

iansilber.en: Design is blurring with PM and engineering, and the future may see more designers than engineers, reversing traditional ratios.
iansilber.zh: 设计与产品、工程的边界正在模糊，未来设计师可能多于工程师，逆转传统比例。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正带来泛化的是多样数据而非单纯体量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上微调，比一味用全量数据训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models and reinforcement learning in post-training will lift robot success and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年他看好语言模型生成的合成数据，以及后训练阶段的强化学习，来提升机器人成功率与速度。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他转向现实约束：物理 AI 容错远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主需靠带人工干预的可扩展强化学习。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，应先通用再微调，且机器人自身经验数据不可替代。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 prior nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的结晶。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口；诚实比光鲜更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会电脑。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition remains the visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，而非单一视角；直觉始终是发自肺腑的罗盘。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI 统治，主张专业化智能将主导；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开源模型与 token 成本下降将重塑企业采用。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and a durable business are now separate; scaling costs can bankrupt companies, so growth must precede margins.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把产品市场契合与可持续业务拆开：Scaling（规模扩张）成本可能让公司破产，因此必须先增长后利润。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat stronger than the app itself and cutting costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他转向后训练：把独特判断与数据固化进模型，形成比应用本身更强的护城河，并降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; data quality and systematic evals matter more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出从提示到 RAG、微调到强化学习的进阶类比人类学习；数据质量与系统化评估比数量更重要。

linqiao.en: Start post-training only after product-market fit, and align training and serving stacks to avoid quality drops from numerical differences.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他给出落地节奏：产品市场契合后再启动后训练，并对齐训练与服务栈，避免数值差异导致质量下降。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是“大棒”；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数几家万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can match huge headcount, so founders must adopt AI workflows.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 浪潮视为风投史上最大机会：小而自主的团队借助智能体可匹敌庞大人员规模，创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software and must stay open-source to prevent a unipolar superintelligence; the future is personal and open, like PCs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 正在民主化软件，且必须保持开源，以防超级智能被单一实体垄断；未来是个人化、开放的，如同个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: AGI won't arrive as one event but diffuse as personal agents you own; skill files in markdown become employees, and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AGI 不会以单一事件降临，而会以你拥有的个人智能体形式扩散；Markdown 技能文件变成员工，个人上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies individual output and will replace mid-level management and per-seat SaaS, though society will take ~20 years to adapt.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体式编程会放大个人产出，并取代中层管理和按席位收费的 SaaS，但社会适应需要约 20 年，这反而是好事。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, first-time-pass silicon, and a startup-like AI team; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠取悦客户、首次流片成功和类似初创公司的 AI 团队重建信任；物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: By 2026 he frames AI as 10x the internet, with agentic and physical AI next; turnaround rests on humility, listening, accountability, and domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为互联网影响力的十倍，智能体式与物理 AI 紧随其后；转型靠谦逊倾听、问责和本土晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: He deepens the CPU thesis: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU central to inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 他深化 CPU 论点：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，使 CPU 成为推理与智能体编排的核心。

lipbutan.en: He broadens to bottlenecks—advanced packaging, glass and diamond materials, interconnect, power, thermal—as the path past physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 他进一步聚焦瓶颈：先进封装、玻璃与金刚石材料、互连、功耗与散热，是突破物理极限的路径。

lipbutan.en: Consistent主线: semiconductors as foundation, customer partnership over competition, and contrarian vertical integration and early semiconductor investing.
lipbutan.zh: 一以贯之的主线：半导体是根基，客户伙伴关系重于竞争，以及逆势的垂直整合与早期半导体投资。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view of the codebase, guiding it with short iterative prompts rather than long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体眼中的代码库，用简短的迭代式提示引导它，而非冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier and harder for agents to navigate.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱、让智能体更难导航。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents before exposing them, since prompt injection remains an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：暴露前先做沙箱隔离，因为提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur; insists on agentic engineering for serious work, reserving vibe coding for late-night play.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当正经说法，严肃工作坚持称智能体式工程，氛围编程只留给凌晨的玩耍。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven annoyance-fixing drive OpenClaw; open source agents run everywhere, and personal brand outlasts any product.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与“跟着直觉修掉烦人之处”驱动 OpenClaw；开源智能体随处可跑，个人品牌比任何产品更持久。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are the key to safety and generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点，开源与共享数据是安全与泛化的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：开源与安全正交，决定安全的是对齐而非开放程度。

thomaswolf.en: By 2026 open source stays near the frontier and wins enterprise adoption on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断开源已贴近前沿模型，并凭成本与控制力赢得企业采用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests, making monitoring harder.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警示：缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与“支线任务”，让监控更难。

thomaswolf.en: He now favors a deliberate slowdown via international cooperation and open science, rejecting the accelerationist label.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他转而主张通过国际合作与开放科学实现有意的放缓，拒绝被贴上加速主义标签。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation make the boundary blurry.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏让两者边界变得模糊。

philipkiely.en: Optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization must be calibrated per workload.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）两类；量化必须按工作负载校准。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，推理工程的重心从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference systems: can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务推理系统仍需人类担责：不能靠感觉写可用性。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you can know they work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年他强调原型制作不可替代：网页本身很混乱，一个想法必须先被做出来、每天使用，才能判断是否成立。

nateparrott.en: Let individual designers leave fingerprints; diverse voices beat a single cohesive team, and feeling matters even in utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年他主张让设计师留下个人印记：多元声音胜过整齐划一的团队，即便是浏览器这类工具型产品也要注入感受与个性。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new technology first; starting from tech and hunting for problems is valid with strong conviction.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一贯鼓励追随好奇心、先摆弄新技术：只要有强信念，从技术出发再找问题是正当路径。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; humans keep a monopoly on good design thinking, models handle busy work.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年他深化判断：工程变容易后，设计与想法成为差异化关键；人类仍垄断好的设计思考，模型只擅长杂活。

nateparrott.en: Be uncomfortably early and ship rough; Claude Design stays a throwaway ideation tool, not production, and models still lack taste.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他更激进：宁可过早、粗糙发布；Claude Design 刻意不做生产工具而做一次性构思工具，因为模型仍缺乏品味。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will define AI software; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, leaving applied AI to startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年他主张：智能体与按结果定价将定义 AI 软件；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在应用层 AI。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but incorrect code means gains require root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年他提出：编码智能体让开发者从写代码变为操作机器，但错误代码意味着收益需靠根因分析才能兑现。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will fall sharply, and agents will be judged by business outcomes, not productivity or token metrics.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调推理成本将大幅下降，智能体应以业务结果而非生产力或 token 指标衡量。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI vendors, not just model providers, will drive innovation; incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：应用层 AI 厂商而非仅模型提供商会推动创新；在位者真正的障碍是商业模式而非技术。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, democratizing expertise along the way.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年他转向治理主线：负责任的迭代部署才是安全之路——先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，同时让专业知识普惠大众。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL-based post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, and evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，而评估在原型开发中定义了何为正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective human craft; diverse, continuous benchmarks are needed to capture creativity and emotional intelligence beyond fixed tests.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了“后训练是主观人工技艺”的判断，主张用多样且持续的基准来衡量创造力与情商，而非固定测试。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; serving one model to billions flattens voice, so more companies should train their own.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，基准须持续演进；同时，一个模型服务数十亿人会趋同成平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; Claude Code empowers non-coders; AGI means profitable indefinite agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：CEO 是否每天使用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标，Claude Code 让非程序员也能自动化本地任务，并把 AGI 定义为能无限运行智能体且经济上有利可图。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; the job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向智能体式工作：每人至少一个智能体，但自动化仍需人类监督；CLI 过时、Codex 等 GUI 成为工作界面；SaaS 不亡反增；“AI 就业末日”是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset and craft; automation commoditizes frozen competencies and creates more expert human work.
danshipper.zh: 同年稍晚，他深化为：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态与手艺；自动化把“冻结的能力”商品化，反而创造更多需要专家定制的人类工作。

danshipper.en: Humans stay central: AI is a tool lacking intrinsic desire, so taste, framing and oversight remain human responsibilities.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终是中心——AI 是缺乏内在欲望的工具，品味、问题框定与监督仍是人的责任，即便超级智能也需人类方向与反馈。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, rather than being trapped in cloud products.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，而不是被困在云端产品里。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变聪明；必须给它包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词，才能用好超级智能模型。

mengto.en: The best creators are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and workflow refinement matter most.
mengto.zh: 最好的创作者是从参考出发迭代的编辑者，而非从零开始；好奇心与持续打磨工作流最重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear, and focus on one painful problem beats diversification.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧，聚焦一个痛点胜过分散多元化。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将随后跟上。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体 harness 与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响胜过等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此应把控制权交还用户。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the pace creates opportunity, and deep understanding of code stays crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化节奏带来机会，而对代码的深度理解始终关键。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5's intelligence leap enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升让更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, not merely preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全与对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption through small-team experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 借小团队实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, and safety enables pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，而对齐让模型敢于反驳。
