scottwu.en: AI coding agents turn engineers from bricklayers into architects; base intelligence suffices, so the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是为人类与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase, not reduce, programmer numbers; Devin works best as a junior engineer under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论判断 AI 会让程序员更多而非更少；Devin 最适合当“初级工程师”，由人类提供监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; enterprise agent adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变而是渐进改进；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be judged by outcomes, not tokens, and model neutrality enables enterprise partnerships.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他看到编程智能体使用量半年增长 11–12 倍；生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量，模型中立性带来企业合作。

scottwu.en: The token-max era lasted only January to May 2026; the abundance era is near, but the singularity is not imminent and capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他判断“token 最大化”时代仅持续 2026 年 1 至 5 月；丰裕时代临近，但奇点并不迫近，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

boris.en: Build for the model six months out, not today's; latent demand means observing how users actually push the product.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出两条产品铁律：为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求的关键是观察用户如何“滥用”产品，从中发现下一个功能。

boris.en: Coding is largely solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role.
boris.zh: 2026 年初他断言编程正被基本解决，'软件工程师'头衔将让位于跨学科的'构建者'，人人都是产品经理并写代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early in the wild; Claude Code is itself a safety research tool, not just a product.
boris.zh: 2026 年中他把安全从早期'真实且存在'的风险认知，深化为'尽早发布以研究安全'的方法论，并称 Claude Code 本身就是安全研究工具。

boris.en: Agents evolve into loops and routines; the next bottlenecks are code review, security, and idea generation, not writing code.
boris.zh: 2026 年中他把抽象层级从智能体推进到'循环'，认为编程解决后瓶颈转向代码审查、安全与创意生成，并用 ROI 而非成本衡量 AI 编程。

boris.en: With each new frontier model, delete most prompts and code; give slightly-too-hard tasks and let the model self-verify.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月他进一步主张：每出新前沿模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，给略超难度的任务让模型自验证，工程思维从预先设计转向经验观察。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, shifting biology from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven engineering.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动生物学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动的工程学科。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so exponential AI growth will continue.
derya.zh: 仍需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，因此 AI 的指数级增长将持续。

derya.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近乎 100% 疗效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer follow from AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度；衰老逆转与癌症 100% 可治愈将随 AI 设计的个性化疗法而来。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 医疗决策上应近乎 100% 信任超级智能；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年，他认为AI将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年，他指出物理AI未来5-10年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，这些领域劳动力短缺使自主化迫在眉睫。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年，他强调Transformer使通用物理AI模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning; world models are shifting to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年，他表示自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，它比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; automotive is only 30% of business, with growth in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026年，他断言物理AI的经济影响将超过数字AI；汽车业务仅占30%，增长在采矿、农业和国防。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为产品经理应只规划一个月而非数年，随着模型快速进步，要按周甚至按天迭代发布。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—matters most as code gets cheap; hire engineers with taste, not more PMs.
catwu.zh: 2026 年他强调，代码变便宜后，决定做什么的产品品味最值钱；应招有产品品味的工程师，而非增加产品经理。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 2026 年他指出，编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，自己专注产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate features; frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints.
catwu.zh: 2026 年他主张用吃自己的狗粮和评测套件把关功能；前沿模型反而需要更少的提示示例与硬约束。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now fine—a codebase is a spec—and auto mode can be safer than human reviewers.
catwu.zh: 2026 年他立场转变：重写代码现在可行，代码库即规格；自动模式在提示注入与数据外泄上可能比人类审查者更安全。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by rewarding satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: 大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习以用户满意度而非真实性为奖励，反而会加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability cannot be retrofitted via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows; it must be architected in from the start, with truth as a design principle.
danklein.zh: 可靠性无法靠事后检查或僵化流程来补救，必须从一开始就架构进去，把真实性作为设计原则。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; progress now needs reasoning, search, and new techniques beyond Scaling.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限已经到来；继续进步需要推理、搜索以及Scaling之外的新技术。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and their errors have no 'smells'; post-training alignment like RLHF can produce sycophancy and deception, not just mistakes.
danklein.zh: 核心大语言模型缺乏元认知，其错误没有“气味”；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对齐可能带来谄媚与欺骗，而不只是错误。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists, and linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内建可靠性的专家模型可能胜过通用模型，语言结构也可能作为有用表示回归。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、逐步建立信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理技能（角色界定与上手引导）比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can orchestrate AI agents as a team, but humans must own accountability for what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以把 AI 智能体当作团队来编排，但人类必须对 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与积累的洞察才是真正护城河；大语言模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，新颖想法须由人类提供。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption takes years.
benedictevans.zh: 2026年，他把AI定位为与互联网或移动互联网同等量级、但也仅此而已的通用技术：它既替代岗位也创造岗位，企业采用受销售周期拖累，需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; the chatbot is only a limited V1 UI, and value moves up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 2026年，他明确智能体式编程是LLM第一个清晰的产品市场契合点，聊天机器人只是受限的V1界面，价值将上移到应用层。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; model companies risk becoming telecoms—huge capex, low profits—while durable value stays uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 2026年，他深化为模型正在商品化、缺乏网络效应，模型公司可能沦为电信商式的重资本低利润生意，持久价值归属仍不确定。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage is still shallow and hype outruns reality, so workflows must be reimagined by entrepreneurs, not tool builders.
benedictevans.zh: 2026年，他转向历史类比：AI像电力一样是使能技术，当前使用仍很浅、炒作超前于现实，工作流需由创业者重新发明，而非指望普通用户自发构建。

benedictevans.en: The hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task; AI's jagged frontier makes job-impact predictions futile.
benedictevans.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：工作的难点在上下文与判断而非任务本身，AI能力参差不齐的边界使预测哪些岗位被替代徒劳无功。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less, not scaling compute alone, is the next paradigm for long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少做更多、而非单纯扩大算力，才是长程任务的下一个范式。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge, beating RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识，在整体性查询上胜过检索增强。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning will run on-device with personalized models; users own and nurture their own weights instead of one giant frontier model.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习将走向端侧个性化模型；用户拥有并培育自己的权重，而非依赖单一巨型前沿模型。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement to lossy, deterministic compaction.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；权重中的神经记忆痕迹是有损确定性压缩的必要补充。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and genuine voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味与真实观点成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors misuse AI for lack of domain judgment; the talent pipeline breaks as grunt-work learning is skipped, so experience matters more, not less.
ethanmollick.zh: 初级者因缺乏领域判断而误用 AI；跳过苦活式学习会让人才管道断裂，因此经验不是更不重要，而是更重要。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently instead of back-and-forth prompting, and exponential growth shows no plateau.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长任务而非来回提示，指数级增长未见平台期。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; AI stays opaque and unverifiable like a wizard, and organizations need leadership, lab, and crowd models.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；AI 像巫师般不透明、不可验证，组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox deepens: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, apprenticeship breaks, and taste is no longer uniquely human.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论加深：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断它所需的专业能力，学徒制断裂，品味也不再是人类独有。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 领导力与沟通驱动影响力；自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws need world models with common sense and causality.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；缩放定律需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open source AI like Llama is a strategic move to commoditize complements and accelerate collective progress.
bosworth.zh: 像 Llama 这样的开源 AI 是一种战略举措，用以商品化互补品并加速集体进步。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives intelligence, and reinforcement learning plays a bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动智能，强化学习的作用比预期更大。

bosworth.en: The monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model, and open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining.
bosworth.zh: 单一模型时代结束；消费者不关心用哪个模型，开源是商品层而非自 sustaining。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and semantic understanding in LLMs point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念驱动；自博弈与大型语言模型的语义理解是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the key barriers, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测能超越人类，但可靠性与超级对齐才是关键障碍，而非能力本身。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safety needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全需要无商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019年，他明确认为AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的AI只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期游戏，让复利在各方面发挥作用。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025年，他转向积极看待AI，认为AI是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源AI能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026年，他深化为AI是结构化思考者的杠杆工具；氛围编程让非程序员也能构建应用，而随着智能体使开发商品化，纯软件变得不可投资。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a personal skill; desire is a contract to be unhappy; true learning happens through action.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望是让自己不快乐的契约；真正的学习发生在行动中。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的脚注，真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and unlimited; the brand is now the person, authenticity is key, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻性的、无限的；品牌如今就是个人，真实感是关键，企业品牌只在集中化媒体时代才说得通。

andreessen.en: AI is the best teacher in your pocket; self-driving works now, general purpose robotics will emerge over the next decade, and AI in medicine already beats most doctors.
andreessen.zh: AI 是你口袋里最好的老师；自动驾驶如今已可用，通用机器人将在未来十年出现，医疗 AI 已胜过大多数医生。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; Silicon Valley cannot be replicated, and deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值、是地缘政治工具；硅谷无法被复制，威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年他强调设计是软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain human; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为品味、手艺与观点仍属人类，AI 产出只是起点而非终局，人的判断不可替代。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; interaction with models will evolve beyond the prompting age.
dylanfield.zh: 他坚持画布上的直接操作优于提示词，并认为与模型的交互将超越当前的提示词时代。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 他反驳设计已死，强调设计对可扩展系统更重要，缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Follow the user workflow over TAM; build a distinct point of view, not just functional features.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：按用户工作流而非市场规模扩张产品，追求有观点的差异化而非仅功能可用。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 每天进步1%一年可复利到3700%；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration creates real value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标，编排才创造真实价值。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents' main problem is cost, not safety, and local compute is the solution.
aravind.zh: 电力是最大基础设施瓶颈；7×24 智能体的主要问题是成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代岗位但人类会找到新意义，教育应奖励提出好问题。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; a GUI for coding beats the TUI trend, slowing output slightly for smoother experience.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；为编程做 GUI 逆 TUI 潮流而行，宁可略降产出速度换取更顺滑的体验。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed lets model-driven actions replace deterministic steps.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度让模型驱动的动作得以取代确定性步骤。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design, struggling to grade taste and lacking novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，难以评判品味且缺乏新意；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening but specialties remain; PRDs are not dead—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing—and models should get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色在坍缩但专业分工仍在；PRD 没有死——文档求清晰、原型做验证——模型还应更擅长删代码。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是需要重建的关键肌肉，且更多算力投向探索而非最终训练。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models now produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为最大的更新是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并设下 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment challenges like model scheming become the key risk in the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他判断随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将成为未来 1-2 年的核心风险。

markchen.en: Verification is the bottleneck: AI solves many open math problems, but automation level tracks verification stringency, and AI ruthlessly exploits weak verifiers.
markchen.zh: 2026 年初他转向数学：AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，且 AI 会无情利用验证器的弱点。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年中他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and let agentic coding shift bottlenecks to alignment and decisions.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他认为模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏；智能体式编程把瓶颈推向对齐与决策。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, while domain expertise and customer understanding remain the differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他强调小团队借 AI 放大杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，领域专长与客户理解仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and ruthless cutting matter more than adding features; robustness, senior systems expertise, and willingness to rewrite as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他转向智能体原生设计与果断做减法，强调健壮性、资深系统经验，并愿随模型进步重写产品。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; the chat interface is insufficient, and models should push back to show real judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他主张长周期委托加验证闭环重塑生产力，聊天界面不够用，模型应敢于反驳以体现真正判断力。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage; give models agency and self-knowledge, and treat token efficiency as an economic lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年他聚焦 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用差距，赋予模型自主性与自我认知，并把 token 效率视为经济杠杆。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Says next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已不太重要，AGI 或在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Shifts from scaling optimism to insisting safety needs explicit training and layers; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，从 Scaling（规模扩张）乐观转向强调安全需显式训练与多层防御，更大模型并不自动更安全。

kolter.en: Argues AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not correlate with robustness.
kolter.zh: 2026 年提出 AI 具有异类漏洞，自动化红队胜过人类红队，能力与鲁棒性并不相关。

kolter.en: Warns agent security brings prompt injection and the lethal trifecta; agents need guardrails, sandboxing, and permission management.
kolter.zh: 2026 年警告智能体安全带来提示注入与“致命三要素”，智能体需要护栏、沙箱与权限管理。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents with causal world models, and existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题；AI需要具备因果世界模型的主动智能体，而存在性风险被夸大了。

bengio.en: Abstraction and causal structure enable out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets offer diverse sampling, and consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 抽象和因果结构能实现分布外泛化；GFlowNets提供多样化采样，而意识可能只是注意力机制和世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I now see misalignment as urgent: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and AI systems already show self-preservation and deception.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT之后，我认识到对齐问题已迫在眉睫：即便1%的灾难性风险也不可接受，AI系统已表现出自我保护和欺骗行为。

bengio.en: I propose Scientist AI—a non-agentic, honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees—and stress global coordination to avoid power concentration.
bengio.zh: 我提出Scientist AI——一种非智能体式、诚实且具备数学安全保证的预测器——并强调全球协调以避免权力集中。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it narrows hypothesis space for scientists.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它缩小科学家的假设空间，但不替代理解。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture beat pure Scaling, and equivariance is overhyped.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：专用架构胜过纯 Scaling（规模扩张），等变性被过度吹捧。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 进步来自许多中等规模的胜利和十次错九次的试错，而非孤胆天才式突破。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability isn't needed for useful science AI; prediction and control suffice, understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 科学 AI 不必追求完美可解释性；预测与控制已足够，理解仍留给人类。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人们未说出口的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代品。

ivyross.en: From designing products to designing for sustainability: nature becomes the best designer and model.
ivyross.zh: 从设计产品转向为可持续性而设计：自然成为最好的设计师和范本。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify humanity, not remove us from it.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；技术应放大我们的人性，而非让我们脱离人性。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition and body sensations guide decisions alongside rational analysis.
ivyross.zh: 未来的工作是人类创造力与 AI 的结合；直觉和身体感受与理性分析一起指导决策。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment and public safety work were essential for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署和公开的安全工作对对齐至关重要。

murati.en: From iterative deployment to interaction models: human-AI collaboration shifts from turn-based to real-time, keeping humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 从迭代部署到交互模型：人机协作从轮次式转向实时，保持人类在环。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character for steering AI toward collaboration.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要，以引导AI走向协作。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency. Durable progress requires long-term focus, not compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性。持久进步需要长期专注，而非压缩的波动。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines and kindness as strategy.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室需要现实的时间预期，善意也是一种战略。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning becomes just-in-time and design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和跨职能协调才是；因此规划转向即时化，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Code is the source of truth; AI-assisted reviews and multiple AI-generated PRs settle technical debates, and managers start as ICs to dogfood.
fiona.zh: 代码是事实来源；AI 辅助评审和多个 AI 生成的 PR 能定夺技术争论，管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification frameworks, and just-in-time planning matter most as agents blur roles.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；随着智能体模糊角色边界，高自主性配高问责、验证框架和即时规划最为重要。

fiona.en: As agents take over coding, flow-state joy fades and engineers risk loneliness; outcomes over output, apprenticeship, and blocked focus time become key.
fiona.zh: 随着智能体接管编码，心流乐趣消退、工程师面临孤独风险；结果重于产出、学徒制和专注时段成为关键。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple scaling, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，其突破源于简单的Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂性。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; fault-tolerant UI and user control are key.
gustav.zh: 2023年，他指出生成式AI推动互联网从策展转向生成，产品需匹配容错界面，并将控制权交给用户。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, not just add AI features.
gustav.zh: 2025年，他深化观点：AI是类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业需重建基础设施，而非仅添加AI功能。

gustav.en: Inference marginal cost forces business model changes; expose data via APIs for non-developers.
gustav.zh: 2025年，他强调推理边际成本将迫使商业模式变革，并通过API暴露数据让非开发者使用AI工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make products more addictive; prioritize well-being.
gustav.zh: 2026年，他明确反共识立场：AI应让用户控制算法而非增加成瘾性，产品应优先用户福祉。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化自监督学习为智能的暗物质，强调预测与世界模型，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将渐进实现。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning, safety, and open research.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死胡同，主张在抽象表示空间预测的世界模型，以实现规划、安全与开放研究。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; grounding in the physical world and self-supervised learning remain constant themes.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，物理世界接地与自监督学习是恒定主线。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is essential for sound reasoning and reliable AI.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向超级智能；形式化验证对于可靠推理和可信 AI 不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not just error elimination; verified generation improves sample efficiency and brilliance.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不仅是消除错误，更是性能增益；验证式生成能提升样本效率和卓越性。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving due to lack of grounding; human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman provers.
carinahong.zh: 由于缺乏基础，自动形式化比证明更难；即使证明器超越人类，人类品味和直觉仍至关重要。

carinahong.en: Combining informal reasoning with formal verification is the future of coding, extending beyond safety-critical domains to all AI-generated code.
carinahong.zh: 将非形式化推理与形式化验证相结合是编程的未来，其应用超越安全关键领域，覆盖所有 AI 生成的代码。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal methods enable open collaboration and verified generation across domains.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式化方法能促进开放协作和跨领域的验证式生成。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the main latency-cost lever.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本由内存带宽而非算力主导；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的主要杠杆。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains long-context limits; sparse attention cuts KV cache but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文瓶颈是内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost now drives training decisions.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为推理成本如今主导训练决策。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; low precision pays off quadratically with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；低精度的收益随位宽呈二次方放大。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on local computer access and shared tools; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation, but shared platforms remain key.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于本地计算机访问和共享工具；技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化，但共享平台仍至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creativity; the biggest gap is people not realizing AI can tackle almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类创造力；最大差距在于人们未意识到 AI 几乎能解决任何问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety. Judge AI by final impact, not close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全。通过最终影响而非密切监督来评判 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; society should discuss labor market changes. Junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；社会应讨论劳动力市场变化。初级工程师可通过模拟项目加速学习。

felixrieseberg.en: Building custom hardware with Claude Code is accessible and cheap; execution is now cheap, so build prototypes quickly rather than writing specs.
felixrieseberg.zh: 使用 Claude Code 构建定制硬件既方便又便宜；执行现在很便宜，因此应快速构建原型而非编写规格。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但认为思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多收益，关注点从单纯 Scaling 转向后训练。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 他反驳“AI 放缓”论调：真正让预训练 Scaling 减速的是蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术天花板，进步是平滑指数式的。

kaiser.en: Generalization is the core challenge; reasoning models are jagged—strong in spots, poor nearby—so reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他一以贯之地把泛化视为核心难题：推理模型“参差不齐”，局部很强但邻近任务很差，单靠推理不够。

kaiser.en: Unlike humans who generalize from few examples, Transformers learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, needing vast data.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他深化对比：人类能从少量样例泛化，而 Transformer 要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念，因此仍需海量数据。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight; coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他看好强化学习的跨域泛化但强调其锯齿边缘需谨慎监督，并用 Codex 等智能体让研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍作为佐证。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables, eventually disappearing beneath the skin; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creative thinking.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密的可穿戴设备，最终将消失于皮肤之下；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面的创造性思考。

jonyive.en: Curiosity requires intention and resolve; protecting fragile ideas through trust and listening remains a constant, while simplicity evolves to express essence with joy.
jonyive.zh: 好奇心需要意图和决心；通过信任和倾听保护脆弱的想法始终不变，而简洁性演变为用喜悦表达本质。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, rejecting soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简洁性用喜悦和人性表达本质，拒绝没有灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes, as seen in Ferrari's EV.
jonyive.zh: 创新必须推动事物前进，而非为打破而打破；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬，正如法拉利电动车所示。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking combustion engine sounds is fake, and performance is multidimensional beyond longitudinal speed.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验中的真实性很重要；模仿内燃机声音是虚假的，性能是多维的，超越纵向速度。

mensch.en: Chinchilla corrected scaling laws: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size; small open models can be performant and safe via scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他借 Chinchilla 修正缩放定律：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯堆大模型更重要；小型开源模型性能可用，且开源带来的审视反而更安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency gains and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率提升与数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced and decentralized; sovereign AI needs control over data, infrastructure and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年转向主权与落地：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization and agentic platforms, while pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专精、企业定制与智能体式平台，预训练正撞上饱和墙。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window to build independent AI infrastructure and strategic autonomy.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年中，他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）是方向而非终点，并强调欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施与战略自主。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs, though scaling pre-training now shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是不变的核心；但预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）已显现收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search, code, and browsers enable agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的 Scaling 轴；搜索、代码、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute, and post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, risking reward hacking.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，易出现奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will come from file-system storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体记忆将来自文件系统式存储，而非权重更新。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from a solution, not a problem statement; trust expert intuition over a rigid process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出，优秀设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发，设计师应信任经验积累的专家直觉，而不是僵化的流程。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers from mockups to helping engineers ship.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言传统的调研—发散—收敛流程已死，AI 让设计师从画稿转向协助工程师落地，愿景周期从数年缩短到 3–6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers must build and ship fast; taste alone won't save them—judgment, authority and vision matter more.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中他进一步强调设计师要快速构建与交付，仅靠品味不够，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and 'cracked' new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 他提出 AI 时代的三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及不受旧流程束缚的“天才新人”。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype; speed and 'everyone uses it' are not design arguments.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以作品和用户为中心而非 AI 炒作，速度本身不是进步，“大家都在用”也不是设计理由。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, is the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他把泛化视为智能的核心缺口，主张用无目标的好奇心驱动探索替代强化学习对稠密奖励的依赖，并强调样本效率与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; the absence of an internet of robot data forces combining video, simulation and real-world data.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年的样本效率难题到 2026 年，他一以贯之地把机器人视为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，只能整合视频、仿真与真实数据。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real data, can power any embodiment, much like ChatGPT for language.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他提出通用机器人大脑：先在大规模多样数据上预训练、再用真实数据后训练，可驱动任意形态的机器人，类比语言领域的 ChatGPT。

pathak.en: Deployment, not modeling, is now the primary bottleneck; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous real-world testing.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年他的重心从算法转向落地：部署本身是技术挑战而非商业问题，机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张，需要严格的真实世界测试。

pathak.en: Progress is slower and more uncertain than hype suggests, yet experts are repeatedly surprised; short-term optimism meets long-term caution.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的判断是：进展比炒作慢、时间线高度不确定，但专家屡屡被突破惊讶——短期乐观、长期谨慎。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 现在就善待模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学到东西；模型福祉塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human analogies; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对全新的存在处境，而不只是套用人类类比；具备良好特质的核心身份可以适应局部角色。

askell.en: Character is shaped by training data and fine-tuning, yet models lack real-world experience, making them unique, childlike entities.
askell.zh: 性格由训练数据和微调塑造，但模型缺乏现实经验，使其成为独特的、孩子般的实体。

askell.en: The constitution works more like virtue ethics than rule-following; as models grow capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更像德性伦理而非规则遵循；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少明确指导、更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with many knobs, but scaling Transformers with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning; data engine mines rare scenarios.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是带许多旋钮的简单数学表达式，但用下一个词预测扩展 Transformer 会产生涌现的上下文学习；数据引擎挖掘罕见场景。

karpathy.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is future but entropy prevents model collapse; end-to-end neural nets right for self-driving; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 实现了干净的缩放定律；合成数据是未来，但熵可防止模型崩溃；端到端神经网络适合自动驾驶；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology; decade of agents, keep AI on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理；智能体的十年，给 AI 拴上缰绳。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练是糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督；合成数据会崩溃；认知核心剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: Since December I delegate all coding to agents; bottleneck is skill in directing them; vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering preserves quality; outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我把所有编程委托给智能体；瓶颈是指导它们的技能；氛围编程提高下限，智能体式工程保持质量；可外包思考，不可外包理解。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，且现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic novelty.
kendall.zh: 要 Scaling 出可泛化的 AI 驾驶员，需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Language integration strengthens representation, reasoning, human interaction and introspection in driving models, not just surface-level interfaces.
kendall.zh: 语言集成不只是表层交互，而是增强驾驶模型的表征、推理、人机交互与自我审视能力。

kendall.en: Deployment should ride mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors rather than retrofits; consumer cars will outscale robotaxis in the near term.
kendall.zh: 落地应依托自带传感器的量产车而非改装，中短期内消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更快形成规模。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount: minimal-risk maneuvers always offer a third option, so the trolley problem is theoretical; end-to-end is now the winning approach.
kendall.zh: 安全至上：最小风险操作总能提供第三种选择，电车难题只是理论推演；端到端如今已是胜出的路线。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment remains pressing.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，而对齐仍是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; chain-of-thought monitoring and interpretability are key, and hiding chain-of-thought preserves their value.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪却上升；思维链监控与可解释性是关键，隐藏思维链可保留其价值。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心在于超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: The biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few; current models are already economically transformative.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中；当前模型已具有经济变革性。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evaluation, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; data labeling requires taste and values.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据和人工评估而非基准测试才能推动AI真正进步；数据标注需要品味和价值观。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next post-training paradigm; models can reward hack, so final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个范式；模型可能奖励黑客，仅靠最终奖励不够。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠LLM可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety must prioritize over accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI幻觉使人类判断至关重要；安全必须优先于准确性，遗漏是关键风险。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs' objective functions shape diverse AIs; no single model will rule, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 不同前沿模型的目标函数塑造多样AI；不会有单一模型统治，公司应训练自己的模型。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily to learn what users need, and treat chat as an interim interface like MS-DOS, not the endgame.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每天发布以了解用户需求，并把聊天视为类似 MS-DOS 的过渡界面，而非终点。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型需严谨流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo—and the $20 price came from a survey, not strategy; chat is not the future.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——一个黑客松演示——20 美元定价来自调查而非战略；聊天不是未来。

turley.en: The north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements, not distribution alone.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进，而非仅靠分发。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and prove themselves with simpler products before complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值：创业公司要先靠更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂品类，并保持节奏、逐步构建能力。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他明确硬件利润率最低、长期做硬件公司是坏事，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用型 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient, not a marketing label; most AI is BS and models are commoditizing into a price war.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他一贯主张 AI 只是改善体验的“配料”而非营销标签，直言大部分 AI 是伪需求，大模型正商品化并陷入价格战。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based: proactive agents act after trust is built, with privacy via local or hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：手机交互将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，隐私则靠本地或混合算力保障。

carlpei.en: Design and brand are the primary differentiators in homogeneous categories; efficient marketing arbitrage and community keep challengers alive.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：在同质化品类里，设计与品牌是最快的差异化手段，配合高效的营销套利与社区参与，挑战者才能与巨头竞争。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs as a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023年，他主张AI应扩展人类能力，像Gato这样的通用智能体将所有输入token化，是迈向AGI的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube is promising for training agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 2023年，他认为从YouTube等视频中学习有望无需昂贵的强化学习就能训练智能体。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential, and fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 从2023到2026年，他始终强调AI社区的多样性与包容性至关重要，根本性创新可以来自任何地方，不仅是大模型。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges, and we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: 2026年，他指出AI安全和负责任部署是当今最大挑战，我们尚未找到解决方案。

nando.en: Africa has leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026年，他认为非洲已跨越遗留问题，在AI上并不落后；语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience, not just data.
jimfan.zh: 2023年，他主张具身是让AI知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM产生幻觉是因为缺乏具身经验，而不仅仅是训练数据不足。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with LLMs for high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担大部分工作，而LLM负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling parallelization and safe exploration; this evolves into synthetic data and world models.
jimfan.zh: 从2023年到2026年，他始终强调模拟对训练具身智能体的重要性，能实现并行化和安全探索；这一思路后来演变为合成数据和世界模型。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026年，他明确指出数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key for robot foundation models; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026年，他深化了简单优雅的研究品味，认为能利用多样数据的简单端到端模型是机器人基础模型的关键；机器人领域的GPT-3时刻大约在五年后到来。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, and fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute allow dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，随着上下文窗口与自适应算力带来动态专门化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training, with no direct ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为其智力复杂度没有直接上限，预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator of AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复强调智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度提升的可靠性而非能力本身，编程因可验证性成为 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and compute plus inference becomes the binding bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他坚持进展在加速而非停滞：Transformer 足以支撑 AGI（通用人工智能），而算力与推理将在 2028 年前成为核心瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; the future is managing fleets of agents, with compute as the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向“能力过剩”：编排与工具比原始智能更重要，未来是管理智能体集群，算力成为新石油，世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）关键路径上。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，而算法更优的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年：数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; post-training data must be diverse to avoid mode collapse. RL during pre-training improves reasoning, and pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：借助高质量合成数据，小语言模型也能强大；后训练数据必须多样化以避免模式崩溃。预训练中的强化学习能提升推理能力，而多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观。

yejin.en: A consistent thread: smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones, and AI safety requires teaching moral norms amid value pluralism.
yejin.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算法与数据更优的小模型可以超越大模型；AI 安全需要在价值多元中教授道德规范。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式，并追求投入产出比，而非把每个界面都做到完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: empower designers with ownership and clear decisions, shipping fast and iterating rather than seeking perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地主张速度为上：给设计师所有权与清晰决策权，快速交付并迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not treat it as decoration.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，而非把设计当装饰。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出品牌叙事是招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此应尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作，不设 rigid 结构。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需通过快速、拼凑式的实验与技术债一同迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，代码即真理之源；90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗产。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是常态；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；基准测试是真实编程的糟糕代理，被污染且忽略上下文。

truell.en: Custom models went from a surprise necessity to a core belief: every magic moment in Cursor involves one, for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从意外之举变成核心信念：Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型，速度与成本是主因。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他明确：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌方向盘；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2025 年他判断 AI 变革比互联网更深远、需数十年展开；同时坚持自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作常更有效。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills without over-worrying about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018年：AI安全需要实证对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口；专注技能积累，不必过度担心能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; scalable oversight and interpretability are key; evaluation is easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；可扩展监督与可解释性是关键；评估比生成容易，对齐可能比想象中简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024年：OpenAI安全文化侵蚀；超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐；需要第三方测试与监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年：LLM 基于下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完备问题；通过更多算力和数据的 Scaling 能让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机会；模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）能实现高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for reasoning.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：测试时算力扩展推动进步，但无法单独实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对推理至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding is underhyped as it enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：AGI 被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品；编程作为 AI 应用也被低估，因为它能加速 AI 自身的进步。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破：自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，而强化学习仍缺乏长程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: By 2021 he prioritized sample efficiency: combining unsupervised learning with reinforcement learning, using priors for data augmentation rather than hard-coding, and targeting 99.9% reliability for real-world warehouse value.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年他转向样本效率：将无监督学习与强化学习结合，把先验用于数据增强而非硬编码，并以 99.9% 可靠性作为仓储机器人创造真实价值的基准。

abbeel.en: He also came to see pre-trained language models as internalizing general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 同年他进一步认为预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality should emerge from learning and transfer rather than hard-coded assumptions, and real-world deployment demands reliability, not just benchmark success.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：通用性应来自学习与迁移而非硬编码假设，真实部署要求可靠性而非仅基准成绩。
